prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production enemy sprite for Depths, a dark stressful first-person pixel dungeon crawler. Silhouette-led restrained pixel art, large crisp clusters, at most three broad shades per material, warm upper-left highlights and dark cool shadows. Flat sparse surfaces, no individual fur, veins smaller than a large readable mark, no pores/grain/noise, no gradients/dithering/antialiasing, no glossy rendering, no ground shadow, background or text. Serious and unsettling, not cute/cartoon. Front-facing full-body transparent square canvas; keep all anatomy/equipment inside with generous 10% margins. Designed to reduce to a native128x128 sprite with max32 shared colours, bottom-centre scene origin (64,120). No scenery or UI. A FOUR-POSE registered sheet of the EXACT SAME hollow miner from reference: same gaunt ashen human face, dead circular cap lamp, brown leather cap, ochre shirt, suspenders, brown trousers/boots, same rusty pick. Square sheet 2x2 equal square cells, one complete figure per cell with generous transparent gutters; no background/labels/grid. Same head/torso/leg scale and kit throughout, foot contact at94% cell height. Top left IDLE slack exhausted swaying, pick hanging low. Top right GRAB: both hands reach toward viewer, shoulders hunched, fingers open, pick safely hanging down from a loop at his LEFT hip so equipment remains visible and hands are free. Bottom left ATTACK: both hands swing the pick down diagonally, complete pick within cell; twist torso, don't enlarge head or body. Bottom right HURT: recoils, one hand against ribs, pick lowered in the other, knees bent, feet planted. Tragic empty gaze, no gore, glow, new tools or exposed organs. Simplify surfaces to broad clear shades, not detailed painting.
